4480:
מִן־, and מִ, before יְ, _prep_. expressing the idea of _separation_, hence **out of**, **from**, **on account of**, **off**, **on the side of**, **since**, **above**, **than**, **so that not**
**1.** with verbs expressing (or implying) _separation_ or _removal_
**a.** **from**, **against**
**b.** מן also, without a verb of similar significance, sometimes expresses the idea of separation, **away from**, **far from**
**c.** of position, **off**, **on the side of**, **on**
**2.** **Out of**, Gk. ἐκ, Lat. ex
**3.** _Partitively_
**4.** Of _time_—
**a.** as marking the _terminus a quo_, the anterior limit of a continuous period **from**, **since**
**b.** as marking the period immediately succeeding the limit **after**
**c.** **towards**, **to**
**5.** (וְעַד) עַד … מִן **from … even to**
**6.** In _comparisons_, **beyond**, **above**
**7.** מן is prefixed to an _infin._:
**a.** with _causal_ force, **from**, **on account of**, **through**
**b.** after verbs implying _restraint_, _prevention_, _cessation_, etc.
**c.** with a _temporal_ force, **since**, **after**
**8.** Once as a _conj_. before a finite verb. **that**
**9.** In compounds:
